says: Files outside the router that still put bytes on disk without the shared record writer (packages/naive/src/store/record-write.ts), each with the number of write calls it makes and why. Most write no record of a venture: a cache or state under .naive/, an append to a log, a temporary file, a moved file, a generated file in this repository, or a file at the workspace level. An entry that says 'cannot move yet' writes a venture's record and names what must change first. The list only shrinks: packages/naive/src/checks/check-direct-writes.ts fails on a new file, on a new call in a listed file, and on an entry that is no longer needed.
